## Workflow 2 – Morning Briefing
Roz subah **8:00 (Karachi)** n8n Data Table **"Boss Tasks"** padh kar boss ko briefing bhejta hai: Overdue, Aaj, Kal, Parson (P1 se P4 order).

**Setup:** Telegram Bot credential ✅. **Send Briefing to Boss** mein `YOUR_BOSS_CHAT_ID` badlo. Time badalna ho to trigger mein hour change karo.

nodeGroups.name: Daily briefing
nodeGroups.description: Reads pending tasks and sends one P1-P4 numbered list (no dates)
